The Coach's Challenge is a genius way to redirect players' complaints towards their own bench instead of the refs By giving teams a formal mechanism to dispute a call, the NBA effectively shifted the burden of proof. Instead of players screaming at the officials for 48 minutes, a referee can simply say: "If you're so sure, tell your coach to challenge it." Now when the whistle blows you have a frustrated Luka furiously twirling his fingers towards the bench, instead of yelling at the officials(Which he still constantly does).

Giannis is OVERRATED Giannis has been overrated for his entire career. He is a great player but has massive weaknesses. These weaknesses make it almost impossible to build a real contender around him. He is a non-center who can’t shoot. That means if your center can’t shoot threes your spacing is screwed and the team is screwed. The only time Giannis won was when he had the perfect roster around him. He had a center that not only was a top rim protector but also a great 3 point shooter. How many centers are like that in the NBA? In addition to having a great 2 way shooting center you need a perimeter player who is WILLING and able to become the #1 option at the end of games. This is because Giannis poor free throw shooting he can’t be the closer. But this scorer has to be willing to defer to Giannis for the entire game until the last 2 minutes. Not many elite scorers are willing to take up that role. Khris Middleton is one of the few. Then the other 2 starters also have to be good 3 point shooters. Even off the bench you need a center who can shoot (Portis) and more shooters. As you can see it is very hard to build around Giannis in order to cover his weaknesses. There is a reason why Giannis never won a single playoff series once Brook Lopez fell off. Even defensively Giannis is extremely overrated. He is one of the most overrated DPOTY ever. During his defensive peak he was surrounded by All NBA defenders and DPOTY candidates. Guys like Brook Lopez, Jrue Holiday, Bledsoe and PJ Tucker. Giannis isn’t an elite rim protector. He frequently gets lost off ball. He isn’t elite guarding the perimeter. With Lopez shutting down the paint and Jrue/Bledsoe cutting off the point of attack, all Giannis had to do was guard the other teams worst offensive player and free-lance. He literally was playing free safety and blowing things up. We all saw when Giannis was forced to defend at center or guard the perimeter. It was ugly. Yes he is a great defender but no where near his reputation. Put him on a team of average defenders and his defense doesn’t make a difference. In 23/24 the Bucks were 19th in defense and Giannis was 29.
